title: Exploration of interaction property between nonylphenol and G protein-coupled receptor 30 based on molecular simulation and biological experiments.
authors: Yang, Lijuan; Chen, Sichong; Chen, Zihao; Sun, Xuefei; Gao, Qinghua; Lei, Ming; Hao, Liying
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子模拟研究环境激素NP与G蛋白偶联受体GPR30的结合模式，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或TF-DNA相关建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Nonylphenol (NP), a representative of environmental hormones, can cause extensive biological effects in the human body. In this study, we first analyzed the mutual binding modes of NP and G protein coupled estrogen receptor 30 (GPR30) by molecular simulation. The 3D structure of GPR30 was successfully constructed. We found that the binding sites of NP on GPR30 are similar to that of 17beta-Estradiol (E2) on GPR30. The GPR30-E2 bond complex is more stable than GPR30-NP bond complex. Next CCK-8 assay was used to detect the regulatory effect of NP on SKBR-3 cell proliferation. When NP and E2 were used alone, low concentration could promote cell proliferation, while high concentration was the opposite. The presence of E2 can promote the cell proliferation effect of NP, and inhibit the inhibitory intensity. NP could promote both the cell proliferation effect and inhibition intensity of E2. Based on our results, we conclude that the binding modes of NP and GPR30 is similar to that of E2 and GPR30. In biology, NP can play estrogen role by activating GPR30 receptor, but it can also produce cytotoxicity at higher concentration.
abstract_zh: 壬基酚（NP）作为环境激素的代表，能在人体内引起广泛的生物效应。本研究首先通过分子模拟分析了NP与G蛋白偶联雌激素受体30（GPR30）的相互结合模式。成功构建了GPR30的三维结构。我们发现NP在GPR30上的结合位点与17β-雌二醇（E2）在GPR30上的结合位点相似。GPR30-E2结合复合物比GPR30-NP结合复合物更稳定。接着，使用CCK-8实验检测NP对SKBR-3细胞增殖的调节作用。当单独使用NP和E2时，低浓度能促进细胞增殖，而高浓度则相反。E2的存在能促进NP的细胞增殖效应，并抑制其抑制强度。NP能同时促进E2的细胞增殖效应和抑制强度。基于我们的结果，我们得出结论：NP与GPR30的结合模式与E2和GPR30的结合模式相似。在生物学上，NP能通过激活GPR30受体发挥雌激素作用，但在较高浓度下也能产生细胞毒性。
